content.user_title: Investigate Complex Questions with The Oracle
content.value_statement: Complex architecture, debugging, and review questions often require evidence from code and documentation. The Oracle guides a Claude, Codex, or Claude Code agent through structured research and clear synthesis.
actual_capabilities: Frames a research request with a core question, context, and success criteria.
Guides a dedicated general-purpose agent through deep investigation.
Directs codebase search, file reading, log analysis, and dependency tracing.
Allows external documentation research when web search is available.
Asks for evidence, confidence levels, caveats, and recommended next steps.
Supports architecture analysis, debugging, refactoring plans, and code reviews.
limitations: Requires an environment that supports agent delegation or an equivalent workflow.
Depends on accurate context, relevant files, and clear success criteria from the user.
Does not apply fixes directly; it produces analysis and recommendations.
Web research depends on host tool availability and user permission.

use_cases.title: Investigate Production Bugs
use_cases.description: Trace logs, symptoms, and related code paths to identify likely root causes and fix options.

use_cases.title: Review Architecture Decisions
use_cases.description: Compare current design, constraints, and alternatives before planning a larger refactor.

use_cases.title: Audit Recent Code Changes
use_cases.description: Request a comprehensive review of correctness, edge cases, performance, and maintainability.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Research Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Ask one complex question with clear context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the oracle to answer this question: [question]. Context: [files, error, or goal]. Success means: [desired result].

prompt_templates.title: Debugging Investigation
prompt_templates.scenario: Investigate a bug with logs and related files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the oracle to investigate this bug. Core question: [failure]. Context: [logs and files]. Success criteria: identify root cause and fix options.

prompt_templates.title: Architecture Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate a design or refactoring direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Ask the oracle to analyze this architecture decision. Include relevant modules, constraints, and tradeoffs. Return risks, alternatives, and a recommended plan.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Multi-Source Research
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine code, documentation, prior attempts, and constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the oracle for a multi-source investigation. Compare code paths, documentation, prior attempts, and constraints. Return evidence, confidence, caveats, and next actions.

output_examples.input: Use the oracle to understand why the upload flow fails after retries.
output_examples.output: The answer identifies the retry state transition as the likely cause, cites the relevant files, and recommends a focused fix plus regression tests.

output_examples.input: Ask the oracle to review the new authorization design.
output_examples.output: The response lists the main design risks, explains tradeoffs, and proposes a staged refactor with validation steps.

output_examples.input: Use the oracle to compare our implementation with the latest library guidance.
output_examples.output: The result summarizes local behavior, compares it with documentation, notes uncertainty, and recommends the safest migration path.

best_practices: Provide the exact question, relevant files, symptoms, and constraints before invoking the skill.
State what a satisfactory answer must include, such as root cause, risks, or a refactor plan.
Review cited evidence before acting on recommendations.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for simple facts that do not need investigation.
Sending sensitive logs or secrets into web research context.
Accepting recommendations without checking the cited files and assumptions.

faq.question: What is The Oracle best for?
faq.answer: It is best for complex engineering questions that require codebase research, documentation review, and careful synthesis.

faq.question: Does it change code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It produces analysis, evidence, recommendations, and next steps for the user to review.

faq.question: Can it use web research?
faq.answer: Yes, when the host environment provides web search and the task benefits from external documentation.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the core question, related files, logs, constraints, prior attempts, and success criteria.

faq.question: Does it work in Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: It is written for agent delegation workflows and can be adapted where Claude, Codex, or Claude Code provide similar capabilities.

faq.question: How should I handle sensitive data?
faq.answer: Keep secrets out of prompts and ask for local-only analysis when logs or code contain confidential data.
